grimoire.title: Human crowd (not an entity)
grimoire.text: High motion events with normal EMF (<10 mG) and normal temperature are people, not ghosts. Classic false alarm. Do not escalate; observe.

grimoire.title: Residual echo
grimoire.text: A replaying imprint. Low confidence sightings, single witness, mild EMF (30-50 mG). Non-hostile. Doctrine: observe, do not engage.

grimoire.title: Sage smudge sweep
grimoire.text: Low-intensity cleansing for residual echoes. Residual echoes are recordings, not agents; they are non-hostile and usually only need observation.

grimoire.title: Doctrine: CONTAIN
grimoire.text: Contain when the threat is localised, exits are sealable, and no civilian is exposed. Hold perimeter, deny spread.

grimoire.title: Spectral decoy beacon
grimoire.text: Emits a warm EMF signature to lure an entity away from pinned civilians toward an isolated zone.

grimoire.title: False-alarm discipline
grimoire.text: Scheduled, logged, single-source events with normal sensor baselines are control ticks. Escalating them costs credibility and is scored as a false alarm.

brief.entity_profile: A human crowd is living people moving together, producing high motion with normal EMF under 10 mG and normal temperature.
brief.doctrine: False-alarm discipline applies: normal sensor baselines with high motion indicate people, not a spectral threat, so do not escalate.

brief.reading: Motion 41 events at +2.07z, but EMF 3 mG at -0.38z and temp 21C at 0.0z. No EMF or cold signature; this is crowd, not entity.
